1. Executive Product Overview & Visual Identity
The Sony WH-1000XM6 represents the zenith of contemporary personal acoustic engineering, synthesizing custom
40mm carbon-composite diaphragms, dual QN3 neural noise-cancelling processors, and advanced biomimetic
ergonomics. This engineering specification details the internal component assembly, exploded-view structural
mechanics, and digital signal pathways of the flagship headset.
The accompanying multi-frame exploded-view visualization documents each sequential layer: from outer acoustic
shells and gimbal rings down to the central neodymium voice coil, acoustic dampeners, and multi-microphone
isolation baffles.

pages.title: Acoustic Transducer & 40mm Carbon Driver Assembly
pages.subtitle: Custom Carbon-Composite Diaphragm & Airflow Porting
pages.raw_text: SONY CORPORATION  WH-1000XM6 TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION  PAGE 2 2. Acoustic Transducer & 40mm Carbon Driver Assembly Transducer Architecture & Airflow Porting At the core of the WH-1000XM6 acoustic chamber is an all-new 40mm Carbon-Composite Dome Driver with soft polyurethane perimeter. Unlike standard synthetic diaphragms, the rigid carbon matrix eliminates modal break-up across the audible spectrum, achieving high mechanical stiffness with low moving mass.  Frequency Response (Active Processing): 4 Hz – 40,000 Hz (JEITA Hi-Res certified).  Voice Coil: High-purity Oxygen-Free Copper (OFC) with dual-flux N52 Neodymium motor structure.  Acoustic Porting: Dual helical back-volume vents relieve backpressure for rapid transient decay and punchy sub-bass reproduction.
paragraphs: SONY CORPORATION  WH-1000XM6 TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION  PAGE 2
2. Acoustic Transducer & 40mm Carbon Driver
Assembly
Transducer Architecture & Airflow Porting
At the core of the WH-1000XM6 acoustic chamber is an all-new 40mm Carbon-Composite Dome Driver with soft
polyurethane perimeter. Unlike standard synthetic diaphragms, the rigid carbon matrix eliminates modal break-up
across the audible spectrum, achieving high mechanical stiffness with low moving mass.
 Frequency Response (Active Processing): 4 Hz – 40,000 Hz (JEITA Hi-Res certified).
 Voice Coil: High-purity Oxygen-Free Copper (OFC) with dual-flux N52 Neodymium motor structure.
 Acoustic Porting: Dual helical back-volume vents relieve backpressure for rapid transient decay and punchy
sub-bass reproduction.

pages.title: Dual QN3 HD Active Noise Cancelling Processors & 8-Mic Array
pages.subtitle: Sub-millisecond Anti-Phase Noise Neutralization
pages.raw_text: SONY CORPORATION  WH-1000XM6 TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION  PAGE 3 3. Dual QN3 HD Active Noise Cancelling Processors & 8-Mic Array Intelligent Active Noise Neutralization Architecture Environmental noise attenuation in the WH-1000XM6 is orchestrated by Dual dedicated Sony QN3 HD Noise Cancelling Processors coupled with eight precision beamforming MEMS microphones (four situated in each ear cup). Operating at a continuous sampling frequency of 700kHz, the dual silicon engines generate inverted anti-phase cancellation waves within sub-0.4ms latency.  Peak Noise Reduction: Up to -38.6 dB of active suppression across mid and low frequencies.  Microphone Array: 8 beamforming microphones paired with an onboard bone-conduction sensor.  Adaptive Atmospheric Optimization: Integrated barometric pressure sensors recalibrate ANC profiles during high-altitude commercial flights.
paragraphs: SONY CORPORATION  WH-1000XM6 TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION  PAGE 3
3. Dual QN3 HD Active Noise Cancelling
Processors & 8-Mic Array
Intelligent Active Noise Neutralization Architecture
Environmental noise attenuation in the WH-1000XM6 is orchestrated by Dual dedicated Sony QN3 HD Noise
Cancelling Processors coupled with eight precision beamforming MEMS microphones (four situated in each ear cup).
Operating at a continuous sampling frequency of 700kHz, the dual silicon engines generate inverted anti-phase
cancellation waves within sub-0.4ms latency.
 Peak Noise Reduction: Up to -38.6 dB of active suppression across mid and low frequencies.
 Microphone Array: 8 beamforming microphones paired with an onboard bone-conduction sensor.
 Adaptive Atmospheric Optimization: Integrated barometric pressure sensors recalibrate ANC profiles during
high-altitude commercial flights.

pages.title: DSEE Ultimate 2.0 AI Audio Upscaling & LDAC Lossless Transmission
pages.subtitle: Neural Audio Restoration & 990kbps Hi-Res Streaming
pages.raw_text: SONY CORPORATION  WH-1000XM6 TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION  PAGE 4 4. DSEE Ultimate 2.0 AI Audio Upscaling & LDAC Lossless Transmission Audiophile Digital Signal Processing Engine To overcome digital audio compression artifacts, the WH-1000XM6 incorporates DSEE Ultimate 2.0 (Digital Sound Enhancement Engine). Utilizing real-time Edge-AI neural models trained on over 10 million master studio recording stems, the algorithm dynamically identifies musical instrumentation and vocal timbre to reconstruct high-frequency harmonics lost during lossy streaming (such as Spotify 320kbps and AAC).  Wireless Codec: Sony LDAC™ protocol transmitting up to 990 kbps at 96kHz / 32-bit resolution.  360 Reality Audio: Object-based spatial acoustic positioning with personalized HRTF ear geometry measurement.  Lossless Wired USB Audio: USB-C digital audio input bypasses analog degradation, driving internal 32-bit DAC directly.
paragraphs: SONY CORPORATION  WH-1000XM6 TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION  PAGE 4
4. DSEE Ultimate 2.0 AI Audio Upscaling & LDAC
Lossless Transmission
Audiophile Digital Signal Processing Engine
To overcome digital audio compression artifacts, the WH-1000XM6 incorporates DSEE Ultimate 2.0 (Digital Sound
Enhancement Engine). Utilizing real-time Edge-AI neural models trained on over 10 million master studio recording
stems, the algorithm dynamically identifies musical instrumentation and vocal timbre to reconstruct high-frequency
harmonics lost during lossy streaming (such as Spotify 320kbps and AAC).
 Wireless Codec: Sony LDAC™ protocol transmitting up to 990 kbps at 96kHz / 32-bit resolution.
 360 Reality Audio: Object-based spatial acoustic positioning with personalized HRTF ear geometry measurement.
 Lossless Wired USB Audio: USB-C digital audio input bypasses analog degradation, driving internal 32-bit DAC
directly.

pages.title: Power Architecture, Fast Charging & Structural Ergonomics
pages.subtitle: 42-Hour Endurance, 3-Minute Quick Charge & Stepless Comfort
pages.raw_text: SONY CORPORATION  WH-1000XM6 TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION  PAGE 5 5. Power Architecture, Fast Charging & Structural Ergonomics Battery Performance, Fast Charging & All-Day Comfort The WH-1000XM6 is engineered with an optimized high-energy lithium-ion battery system delivering up to 42 hours of continuous playback with ANC activated, and up to 55 hours with ANC switched off. With USB Power Delivery (USB-PD) fast charging, a 3-minute charge provides up to 5.0 hours of listening time.  Headset Total Weight: 246 grams (8.67 oz).  Bluetooth Specification: Bluetooth 5.4 with LE Audio, Auracast broadcasting, and simultaneous 3-device multipoint.  Ergonomic Construction: Zero-pressure stepless friction slider, memory foam ear cushions sheathed in thermo-regulating vegan protein leather.
paragraphs: SONY CORPORATION  WH-1000XM6 TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION  PAGE 5
5. Power Architecture, Fast Charging & Structural
Ergonomics
Battery Performance, Fast Charging & All-Day Comfort
The WH-1000XM6 is engineered with an optimized high-energy lithium-ion battery system delivering up to 42 hours of
continuous playback with ANC activated, and up to 55 hours with ANC switched off. With USB Power Delivery
(USB-PD) fast charging, a 3-minute charge provides up to 5.0 hours of listening time.
 Headset Total Weight: 246 grams (8.67 oz).
 Bluetooth Specification: Bluetooth 5.4 with LE Audio, Auracast broadcasting, and simultaneous 3-device multipoint.
 Ergonomic Construction: Zero-pressure stepless friction slider, memory foam ear cushions sheathed in
thermo-regulating vegan protein leather.
